data.one_liner: A Flutter package to create a circular menu using a Floating Action Button.
data.what_it_does: Provides a floating action button widget that expands into an animated circular menu containing multiple child widgets. The menu layout can be customized via various properties like ring color, diameter, and width, and can be handled programmatically using a global key.
use_when: You want a circular expansion menu attached to a Floating Action Button
You need a visually engaging way to present multiple actions behind a single FAB
avoid_when: You require standard linear or dropdown menus
You need heavy custom layout control outside the predefined circular pattern
strengths: Easy to integrate with minimal setup
Supports programmatic control via a key (open, close, check status)
weaknesses: Limited active maintenance reported by the author
Fixed circular arrangement may not fit every design system
